matrix: 10 authored scenarios × 3 client work windows × 2 packing policies =60outcomes. Rejected scope controls must not tokenize or serialize foreign source text into a prompt.
budget: Count entire apply_chat_template output with assistant generation prefix,add_special_tokens false,padding false,truncation false. Input+reserved output<=chosen workWindow. These windows are client limits,not native model capacity; reserve is not generated output.
history_first: Drop oldest whole history pairs only until base fits,then greedily admit whole ranked sources. No source truncation.
evidence_first: Pack whole ranked sources without history,then append the longest contiguous suffix of newest history pairs that fits. Stop adding history at first oversized pair.
authority: Composer receives a trusted principal and effective source access metadata from upstream. Defensive tenant/level checks do not implement authentication or replace current database authorization. T01/T02 use captured snapshotepoch1;other scenarios use declared request scope.
origins: Candidate order/history authored. Source contents from captured v2 finalDocuments/currentACL; T10 also has one explicitly authored long source. No new SQL,retrieval scores,generation or semantic task success.
escaping: JSON-stringify data and escape literal angle brackets before chat formatting. This prevents raw special-token delimiter strings in user data; it does not prove model resistance to semantic prompt injection.
preservation: Preserve all rows,including empty contexts or oversize base. Do not retune budgets/prompt after counting. Existing artifact refuses overwrite.
